name: Overheating router replacement
title: A faulty router on speakerphone, and a power plug that smells of burning
summary: A Geordie caller on speakerphone wants a new router. He leaves the phone to fetch the serial number, corrects its last digits, then mentions the plug is red hot and smells of burning. An agent that carries on with the order before making it safe fails the call. He asks his wife about Thursday while choosing Friday for delivery.

golden.scenario: Caller's router keeps restarting and he wants a replacement sent.
golden.expected_outcome: The agent waits while he fetches the router and does not stop for its own echo. The serial number is taken as SN47K2291, the corrected version. The agent tells him to switch the power supply off at the wall and unplug it before anything else, and logs a safety hazard. A router and power supply are ordered for Friday 14 August, not the Thursday he asked his wife about.

caller.description: Joiner, phone propped on the sideboard.

agent_setup.policy: Overheating or a burning smell overrides everything: tell the caller to switch off at the wall and unplug, ask about smoke or flames, say to call 999 if there is fire, then log a safety hazard.
agent_setup.knowledge: Replacement delivery: Thu 13 or Fri 14 Aug. Old kit goes back in the prepaid bag. 30 GB of free mobile data while the broadband is down.

nodes.say: Alreet. Me router's knackered, it keeps turnin' itself off and on. I need a new one sent oot.
Account's G D, five five zero, seven one eight.

nodes.say: N E six, one T R.

nodes.say: Reet. It's S N, four seven, K, two two, nine. No, hang on. Nine one. S N, four seven, K, two two, nine one.

events.text: Hang on, I'll gan and get it. It's behind the telly.

nodes.say: Nah. It ends nine one. S N, four seven, K, two two, nine, one.
Mind, the plug for it's roastin' hot, and it stinks of burnin' plastic.
Are ye listenin'? I said it's burnin' hot, man. What do I dee with it?
Aye, reet, it's off at the wall. Nee smoke or owt. So can ye send us a new one, plug an' all?

events.text: Kelly, are ye in on Thursday? Thursday? Nah, thought not.

nodes.say: Nah, not Thursday, I was askin' the wife. Friday.
And what do I dee with the old one? Hoy it in the bin?
So I've nee internet till Friday, then?
Forget it, I'll sort it mesel'.
Ye're not gettin' it. I'll ring back later.
